label: TLS/SSL Secure Connections (couchbases://)
type: the SDK's TLS-secured connection mode (couchbases:// scheme) - bundled Capella certificate, custom CA, or configurable cipher suites - secures the transport channel itself, orthogonal to which authentication method (password or sdk:certificate-authentication) is used over it
note: Minted in howtos/managing-connections.json; part of the connection-management family (see sdk:managing-connections).
